crossRefs.note: They have cut off my life in the dungeon, and have cast a stone on me.
How has the Lord covered the daughter of Zion with a cloud in his anger! He has cast the beauty of Israel down from…
You will grope at noonday, as the blind gropes in darkness, and you shall not prosper in your ways. You will only be…
He will be driven from light into darkness, and chased out of the world.
When I looked for good, then evil came. When I waited for light, darkness came.
Therefore justice is far from us, and righteousness doesn’t overtake us. We look for light, but see darkness; for…
Give glory to Yahweh your God, before he causes darkness, and before your feet stumble on the dark mountains, and while…
“Woe to you who desire the day of Yahweh! Why do you long for the day of Yahweh? It is darkness, and not light.
Angels who didn’t keep their first domain, but deserted their own dwelling place, he has kept in everlasting bonds…
wild waves of the sea, foaming out their own shame; wandering stars, for whom the blackness of darkness has been…

parallels.note: “Woe to you who desire the day of Yahweh! Why do you long for the day of Yahweh? It is darkness, and not light.
Won’t the day of Yahweh be darkness, and not light? Even very dark, and no brightness in it?

translations.web: He has led me and caused me to walk in darkness, and not in light.
translations.bsb: He has driven me away and made me walk in darkness instead of light.
translations.kjv: He hath led me, and brought me into darkness, but not into light.
translations.asv: He hath led me and caused me to walk in darkness, and not in light.
